title: Subagent Status Envelope
description: Required wire format for every implementer or judge subagent return. Loaded by /do-and-judge, /do-in-steps, and the subagent-orchestration skill. No jsonschema runtime dep — the authoritative validators are src/scripts/_lib/subagent_response.ts (body) and src/scripts/_lib/subagent_capsule.ts (CHECKPOINT capsule), covered by tests/scripts/_lib_subagent_response.test.ts and tests/scripts/_lib_subagent_capsule.test.ts.

status.description: DONE = work shipped, gate green. DONE_WITH_CONCERNS = work shipped but caller must read concerns[]. NEEDS_CONTEXT = paused, blocking_question[] must be answered. BLOCKED = halted, blocking_reason describes why no path forward. CHECKPOINT = the worker reached its budget watermark and hands off a state capsule; done/remaining/generation are required.

summary.description: One- or two-sentence outcome. Required for every status.

evidence.description: Citations: file:line, command output, test name, contract section. Required for DONE / DONE_WITH_CONCERNS.

concerns.description: Caller-actionable concerns. Required when status = DONE_WITH_CONCERNS, must be empty otherwise.

blocking_question.description: Single specific question whose answer would unblock. Required when status = NEEDS_CONTEXT.

blocking_reason.description: Why no path forward exists. Required when status = BLOCKED. Distinguish from NEEDS_CONTEXT (where caller can supply context).

next_action.description: What the caller does now. Optional; orchestrator infers from status when omitted.

generation.description: CHECKPOINT only. Generation index in the recycling chain; the first dispatch is 1.

done.description: CHECKPOINT only. What is finished — ref tokens (file:line, id, path), never bodies.

remaining.description: CHECKPOINT only. What is left, one short line each.

decisions.description: CHECKPOINT only. Choices already made that the successor must not silently re-open.

open_risks.description: CHECKPOINT only. Risks still open at handoff.

touched_files.description: CHECKPOINT only. Paths / file:line this generation touched — never diffs.

assumptions.description: Stated premises the successor inherits instead of re-deriving. Valid on a CHECKPOINT capsule AND on a completed worker result — unstated assumptions are the first thing compression drops.

basis.description: Ref token the premise rests on.

epistemic_state.description: The Evidence-Report buckets from evidence-discipline.md — the capsule does not get a private grading scale.
